text.en: The compilation retains 2 rows and 26 populated trait columns for this source concept. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 2 rows and 12 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are F, M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 2 rows and 5 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are F, M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

text.en: The compilation retains 1 rows and 8 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 2 rows and 13 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are F, M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.
text.zh: 汇编为这一来源概念保留 2 行，13 个性状列含有非空记录。性别代码为 F、M：F、M 分别为来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 为幼体材料，NA 为未指定类别。汇编行数不是去重的标本数；不同性别、发育阶段和文献的值不能合并成一个鉴别尺寸。缺失单元格也不代表相应解剖结构不存在。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 1 rows and 10 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 1 rows and 17 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are M: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.
text.zh: 汇编为这一来源概念保留 1 行，17 个性状列含有非空记录。性别代码为 M：F、M 分别为来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 为幼体材料，NA 为未指定类别。汇编行数不是去重的标本数；不同性别、发育阶段和文献的值不能合并成一个鉴别尺寸。缺失单元格也不代表相应解剖结构不存在。

These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.

text.en: The version 3 deposit records Walkerana diplosticta within Walkerana, Ranixalidae, Anura. Its source concept is retained independently of current COL26.8 species. Original trait cells, sex codes and bibliographic rows accompany this record.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Walkerana diplosticta 记在 Walkerana、Ranixalidae、Anura 下。此来源概念与当前 COL26.8 物种分别保留；原性状单元格、性别代码和书目行附在本记录中。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The compilation retains 2 rows and 30 populated trait columns for this source concept. Recorded sex codes are M, F: F and M denote the source female and male categories; J denotes juvenile material, and NA leaves the category unspecified. These are compiled rows rather than unique specimen counts. Values from separate sexes, life stages and publications must not be pooled into a single diagnostic size. Missing cells do not establish absence of an anatomical structure.
text.zh: 汇编为这一来源概念保留 2 行，30 个性状列含有非空记录。性别代码为 M、F：F、M 分别为来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 为幼体材料，NA 为未指定类别。汇编行数不是去重的标本数；不同性别、发育阶段和文献的值不能合并成一个鉴别尺寸。缺失单元格也不代表相应解剖结构不存在。
